+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException
+from fastapi.security import APIKeyQuery, APIKeyHeader, APIKeyCookie, HTTPBearer, HTTPDigest, OpenIdConnect
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from starlette.status import HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+# Define schemes
+api_key_query = APIKeyQuery(name="api_key")
+api_key_header = APIKeyHeader(name="X-API-Key")
+api_key_cookie = APIKeyCookie(name="api_key")
+http_bearer = HTTPBearer()
+http_digest = HTTPDigest()
+oidc = OpenIdConnect(openIdConnectUrl="https://example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration")
+
+@app.get("/query")
+async def read_query(key: str = Depends(api_key_query)):
+    return {"key": key}
+
+@app.get("/header")
+async def read_header(key: str = Depends(api_key_header)):
+    return {"key": key}
+
+@app.get("/cookie")
+async def read_cookie(key: str = Depends(api_key_cookie)):
+    return {"key": key}
+
+@app.get("/bearer")
+async def read_bearer(token: str = Depends(http_bearer)):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+@app.get("/digest")
+async def read_digest(credentials: str = Depends(http_digest)):
+    return {"credentials": credentials}
+
+@app.get("/oidc")
+async def read_oidc(token: str = Depends(oidc)):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_schemes():
+    schemes = [
+        ("/query", "APIKeyQuery"),
+        ("/header", "APIKeyHeader"),
+        ("/cookie", "APIKeyCookie"),
+        ("/bearer", "HTTPBearer"),
+        ("/digest", "HTTPDigest"),
+        ("/oidc", "OpenIdConnect"),
+    ]
+    
+    for path, name in schemes:
+        response = client.get(path)
+        print(f"{name}: {response.status_code}")
+        # Currently it is 403, we want it to be 401
+        assert response.status_code == HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, f"{name} should return 403 (current behavior)"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_schemes()
+        print("All current checks passed (returned 403)")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Assertion failed: {e}")
+        exit(1)
